title: Why “công nghệ” is trending in VN: 200+ searches, the facts (November 13, 2026)
description: “công nghệ” is trending in VN with 200+ searches reported by Google. The verified coverage behind the spike, from Báo Công Luận and 2 more.

sections.heading: What is trending: “công nghệ”
paragraphs: “công nghệ” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for VN (snapshot taken 2026-11-13T22:38:09+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 200 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from Báo Công Luận, VnExpress, Znews. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Alice Huang quen cựu CEO Nvidia nhờ chồng” — Znews
“Thế khó với Nvidia khi điều tra bê bối của Jensen Huang” — VnExpress
“CEO tạm quyền Colette Kress của Nvidia là ai?” — Báo Công Luận

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Fri, 13 Nov 2026 13:00:00 -0800. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-11-13T22:38:09+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-11-13T22:38:17+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.

faq.q: How many people searched for “công nghệ”?

This snapshot covers VN. The same term may trend differently in other regions.
